receipt.description:
Magnus Carlsen reacts to his most viral and funny chess moments. From Magnus Carlsen slamming the table against Gukesh in chess, to Hikaru vs Magnus, to Magnus Carlsen's fastest checkmate and even the Botez sisters and GothamChess with Magnus Carlsen. 

📍 Boulevard Riyadh City
🗓️ July 7th - August 24th, 2025
🎟️ https://webook.com/en/events/esports-world-cup

▶ More at:
♦ EWC: https://esportsworldcup.com
♦ X: https://x.com/EWC_EN & https://x.com/EWC_Extra
♦ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ewc_en & https://www.instagram.com/ewc_extra/
♦ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@ewc_en  & https://www.tiktok.com/@ewc_highlights
♦ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/esportsworldcup              

We at the Esports World Cup found all of Magnus Carlsen's most viral chess moments and clips and forced him to react to them.   This is not Magnus Carlsen answers your chess questions like the last video on the channel or normal interviews like Take Take Take. This is a chess reaction video!

#EsportsWorldCup #EWC25
